messages:
nora: FYI — Orion POC blocked. SCIM returns 403 scope_error and SAML login shows 'Signature algorithm mismatch'. They moved from Hosted -> Dedicated/VPC and pasted keys during cutover. Need quick triage.
ben: can you paste the recent scim-proxy lines and the SAML signature error? also which token did they paste into Dedicated?
ash: short notes: Dedicated tenant keys are region+tenant scoped and require sha256-signed assertions if our metadata advertises sha256. If IdP uses sha1 the signature check fails.
nora: logs (redacted):
```
scim-proxy: 403 token_scope_error - token audience: hosted_api, expected: tenant:orion-eu
saml-verify: signature algorithm 'rsa-sha1' not allowed, expected 'rsa-sha256'
```
ben: two independent fixes: 1) SCIM — they likely pasted hosted key (rudx-abc123) into tenant field. Need tenant key starting 'rudx-tenant-'. 2) SAML — ask IdP to switch signing algorithm to rsa-sha256 or provide an SP metadata override.
ash: immediate mitigation: we can issue a temporary tenant-scoped token for eu region (ttl 3h). And we can accept rsa-sha1 for this specific onboarding app if customer signs a security waiver (short-term) while they update Okta.
nora: customer says their IdP admin controls signing alg at org-level and needs time. They accepted temp token and will change signing alg after business hours.
idp-bot: temp token issued: rudx-tenant-eu-temp-orion-3h (expires 2187656400).
ben: provide this curl test to validate SCIM path: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer rudx-tenant-eu-temp-orion-3h" https://eu.scim.redwood.company/dedicated/orion/Users`
nora: they ran it -> 200 and returned user list. SCIM provisioning resumed.
ash: for SAML, we sent metadata + instructions to change signing alg to SHA256 and a fallback: create a dedicated Okta app for Redwood with per-app signing alg override.
nora: customer updated Okta app to rsa-sha256 and uploaded full cert chain. SAML login passed.
idp-bot: SCIM job 9912 complete: 51 created, 2 updated, 0 errors.
ben: follow-up: we'll add a console heuristic to warn when a hosted-style key is pasted into tenant field and a docs blurb about signature alg mismatch. Filed DOCS-118.
nora: Orion confirmed POC provisioning and SSO. Closing thread, thanks! :white_check_mark:
